** Minor** · **Security & Privacy** · **Quick win** **Do not expose PHP error messages to validation clients.** Null Point coordinates trigger a `TypeError` whose message includes the parser’s file path and line number. ([github.com](https://github.com/php/php-src/blob/PHP-8.2/Zend/zend_execute.c)) If an application returns validation errors to clients, `$fail` exposes those details. Return a safe invalid-GeoJSON message for PHP errors. Log the original error separately if needed.

Merge Risk: Low · up to 3bc84
